reviews.text: Nancy is an incredible healer! She integrates her extensive knowledge of the body's inner workings with warmth and patience. I have suffered from chronic back pain for 3 years due to a spinal injury. Just a few months into taking Pilates privates, and I am happy to report that I live mostly pain-free! And when I tweak my back, I now have the knowledge and tools to figure out how to rehab on my own. Nancy is truly an "empowerer" in her approach. I have fallen in love with my own body, thanks to Pilates and Nancy's encouragement and love.
reviews.author: Sarah Myers
